Based on the document provided, I can only identify obligations and exemptions related to **application/screening fees** in Berkeley as of 2026-10-01. The document does not contain information about rent caps, just cause eviction, deposits, screening restrictions, or algorithmic pricing.

## Application/Screening Fees

**Screening Fee Cap:**

citations.cited_text:
Screening Fee
The maximum tenant screening fee for 2026 is
$68.96
Landlords may use screening fees to obtain information about a prospective tenant like a consumer credit report.

citations.cited_text: Prospective tenants should expect to receive a copy of their credit report within 7 days of receipt by the landlord, a receipt for the fee paid and an itemized list of any out-of-pocket expenses and time spent by the landlord on the screening, and a refund of any unused portion of the fee.

content.text: Prospective tenants should expect to receive a copy of their credit report within 7 days of receipt by the landlord, a receipt for the fee paid and an itemized list of any out-of-pocket expenses and time spent by the landlord on the screening, and a refund of any unused portion of the fee.

citations.cited_text: If the tenant provides a reusable screening report, the landlord must use it.

content.text: If the tenant provides a reusable screening report, the landlord must use it.

citations.cited_text: The landlord cannot charge a prospective tenant a screening fee if no rental unit is actually available.

content.text: The landlord cannot charge a prospective tenant a screening fee if no rental unit is actually available.

citations.cited_text: The landlord must also return a screening fee to any applicant not selected, or have a policy under which they: (1) review applications in the order received and the first qualified applicant gets the unit, and (2) do not charge a screening fee to any applicant not considered.

content.text: The landlord must also return a screening fee to any applicant not selected, or have a policy under which they: (1) review applications in the order received and the first qualified applicant gets the unit, and (2) do not charge a screening fee to any applicant not considered.

citations.cited_text:
Prohibition of non-refundable application fees associated with existing tenancies (BMC 13.78.016)
An owner of residential rental property (or the owner’s agent) cannot charge a non-refundable fee to any existing tenant for the purpose of renewing a tenancy, in whole or in part, including any fee associated with the departure of a roommate or to request to add or replace a roommate in a pre-existing household.

content.text: An owner of residential rental property (or the owner's agent) cannot charge a non-refundable fee to any existing tenant for the purpose of renewing a tenancy, in whole or in part, including any fee associated with the departure of a roommate or to request to add or replace a roommate in a pre-existing household.

citations.cited_text:
Notification of state law limitation on tenant screening fees (BMC 13.78.010)
When an owner or the owner’s agent gets a request to rent residential property in Berkeley from an applicant and the owner charges a fee to purchase a consumer credit report and to validate, review, or otherwise process an application, the owner must provide, either in the rental application or in a separate disclosure before receiving the fee, a clear and conspicuous tenant screening fee rights statement and a statement of the maximum fee cap permitted under
California Civil Code Section 1950.6(b)
.

citations.cited_text:
Applicability to Existing Rental Agreements (BMC 13.78.018)
Chapter 13.78 applies to all residential rental agreements regardless of any contractual language in any rental agreement or lease to the contrary.

content.text: Chapter 13.78 applies to all residential rental agreements regardless of any contractual language in any rental agreement or lease to the contrary.

citations.cited_text: Any provision of an existing rental agreement or lease that violates the provisions of this chapter are unenforceable.
